_note: V5_DESIGN section 16. innuendo and flirt lines carry a heat level (1 flirt, 2 cheeky, 3 very cheeky); never explicit, never with or about a child. Other topics are plain strings. Slots: {other} {name} {a} {b} {place} {reason}. Built by tools/content_src/build_content.js; edit the sources there.

innuendo.text: {other}, my suit has a quick-release. Just so you know. For emergencies.
Pressure is rising in here, {other}, and I am not talking about the cabin.
I am told I have excellent torque. The rover mechanic put it in writing.
One airlock cycle, you and me. Eight minutes. I counted. I am not nervous.
Your hydroponics are looking very healthy, {other}. Lots of growth. Lots of green.
I checked all the seals today. Yours too, {other}? I mean your schedule. Your schedule.
Careful. I tend to run hot when I am near a good power source.
{other}, I would love to see your pipework. For the ship. Obviously the ship.
They say a tight fit is a good fit. I was talking about the hatch. Mostly.
I read the manual twice, {other}. There is a section on cuddling in a confined space. Page nine.
If we run low on oxygen, I volunteer to share. Breath by breath. Slowly.
{other}, is it warm in here, or did somebody turn up the sun lamps on me?
My rover has a very comfortable back seat. I am only mentioning it as a fact.
I am great with small spaces, {other}. Ask anyone. Ask the cupboard.
You make my heart rate go up. The doctor says that is cardio. I say it is you.
I would love to inspect your equipment, {other}. For compliance. Weekly compliance.
Tonight the habitat lights are low. Nice mood lighting for a walk.
{other}, I have been told I am very good with my hands. The kitchen staff can confirm.
I keep a spare O-ring in my pocket. Ask me why. Or do not. Better to ask.
The guide says to sleep in shifts. I am free after yours, {other}.
{other}, our shift patterns match so nicely. Almost like fate. Or a rota.
I have a very firm handshake. Also a very soft side. You can pick which one to test.
My flight record is clean, {other}. Safe landings only. Smooth ones.
The AI says we are a ninety-four percent match. It said that about my toaster too. Still, I am hopeful.
Would you like to see my airlock? It is very clean. Nobody has used it in months.
You are in my personal space, {other}. Please stay. I find I like it here.
I stretched this morning. Every muscle. In case somebody needs a very flexible partner.
Is that a wrench in your pocket, or are you just happy to fix my pipes?
{other}, you do not need a suit around me. I have enough heat for two.
I defrosted a very nice dinner for two, {other}. It is lasagne. It is also a metaphor.
Between you and me, {other}, the oxygen tastes better when you are in the room.
I have been practising my spacewalk. I need a partner for the tether. A close one.
My bunk is rated for one. I would be happy to test its limits with you.
{other}, you hum when you work. I have started finding excuses to be in earshot.
Funny. The colony has a hundred rooms and I keep ending up where you are.
I am told the dome has excellent acoustics. I would like to find out with you.
{other}, I could fix your schedule. Or at least clear your evenings.
My grandmother said, find someone who can fix a pump. I think that is you.
You are the only person here who makes a rationed meal feel like a banquet.
If the lights go out, {other}, I know the way. To your quarters. I mean the exit. The exit.
I like how you handle a tool, {other}. Calm. Sure. Very, very precise.
Is it me, or is the gravity getting stronger? I keep falling for you.
There is a rumour that I am shy. I would like to correct that. Privately.
{other}, do you cook? Because things are getting steamy in this kitchen.
I have never had a problem with intimacy. Just with the airlock schedule.
You look good in that uniform, {other}. I like the way it fits. The uniform. The standard issue.
I am a very slow charger. Worth the wait, though. Many have said so.
Come over later. I will bring the snacks. You bring the questionable decisions.
I would never ask you to take off your helmet. Unless we are inside. And alone.
The doctor told me to get more exercise. I immediately thought of you.
{other}, I do my best work when someone is watching. Please stay and watch.
I am not saying you are hot. I am saying the thermostat has stopped working near you.
Nobody talks about how cosy a rover cabin is after dark.
I would love to give you a tour of my quarters. It is short. I will make it last.
Rumour says you are good under pressure, {other}. I have a pressure chamber booked.
You have lovely thrusters. I mean on your boots. The boots are great.
{other}, I have been practising a very careful docking manoeuvre. I need a volunteer.
Our oxygen budgets look compatible. Maybe we should merge accounts.
Not to brag, but I can make a ration bar last for hours. Very patient. Very thorough.
{other}, nothing makes me feel more alive than a nearly failed seal. Except maybe you.
I read that people in confined spaces bond fast. Let us confine ourselves, for science.
You said you needed a hand in the greenhouse. I have two. Both free tonight.
It gets cold at night. I hear body heat is the most efficient resource we have.
I am the kind of person who reads the whole warranty, {other}. I am committed.
{other}, you have a nice rhythm when you walk. It is very, hmm, regulated.
The AI recommends we spend more time in close contact. It said so in the wellness newsletter.
I could take a look at your drive coupling. It sounds a little loose. Or lonely.
If you need a partner for the zero-g class, I am very flexible. Also very sincere.
Come on, {other}. The coolant can wait. Let us generate some heat of our own.
I put your name on my emergency contact list. Under both things I would call about.
{other}, when you laugh the lights flicker. That is a lot of power.
I spent my credits on a very small, very nice bottle of wine. The label says patience. I say tonight.
My quarters have a window. A small one. It is perfect for two people looking at one star.
You keep looking at my hands, {other}. They are free after dinner.
I have a very good bedside manner. I am a doctor of nothing, but I commit.
Warning, {other}: prolonged eye contact may lead to a full-blown mess hall scandal.
They gave me a safety briefing on you. Highly flammable. Handle with joy.
I have an excellent sense of timing. Ask my metronome. Ask the pump cycle.
You stir the stew like you stir my thoughts. Slowly. In circles. Until nothing is left.
My capacity is much larger than the spec sheet says. Please test it.
I would love to get lost with you, {other}. In the corridors. The long ones. With the dim lights.
Do not worry about the camera in the corridor. I filed it under maintenance.
I propose a mutual exchange of resources. Starting with warmth.
{other}, I am a simple person. I like good coffee, good company, and a good lock on the door.
Your dedication to the job is inspiring. I would like to see more of your dedication to leisure.
The pressure valve in my quarters needs checking. Needs a lot of checking. All evening.
I am very reliable when it comes to maintenance. Regular. Thorough. Gentle on the moving parts.
Say the word, {other}, and I will reschedule my whole week around your lunch break.
I told the AI my ideal evening. It recommended you. I did not even type your name.
You are the best thing in this colony that does not require a permit.
Looking for a partner for the night shift. Duties include warming a chair and not talking about work.
It is almost the end of the cycle, {other}. We should wrap up. In blankets. Together.
{other}, I filed an expense claim for flowers. They only had lettuce. I hope it says enough.
I can be very quiet when I need to. The vents can attest. The vents have heard things.
Do you want to see how my backup generator works? It is a very short demonstration.
If this is a dream, {other}, please do not file a wake-up report.
I could live on this ration bar if I knew I could share the rest of the evening with you.
Nothing says romance like two people, one tether and a very slow airlock.
My bunk and I have a lot of room. We have been discussing it. We both think of you.
Your voice is the only thing on the intercom I do not mute.
{other}, I will bring the music, you bring the mood. We will not need a third party.
I prepared a toast: to the engineers, to the doctors, and to the very lucky person at my door.
Would you like to practise a very long, very slow handover? Of shift duties. Obviously shift duties.
I will be in the maintenance tunnel after dinner. It is very narrow. It is perfect for two.
Your turn to buy the next round, {other}. I will pay you back. In kind. Slowly.
Every time you adjust that harness, I forget how to adjust mine. Please stay nearby.
We could share a blanket. For efficiency. Colonial efficiency. Very serious.
You look like someone who knows how to keep a secret. I have one. It is about you.
{other}, my quarters have a lock, a lamp and a very quiet ventilation system. Just listing features.
I have been told I am a very hands-on leader. Come to my office. Bring a clipboard. Leave it at the door.
The maintenance closet has excellent privacy and almost no windows. I was just inspecting it, naturally.
Last night I dreamt we were stuck in the airlock. The cycle took six hours. Nobody complained.
{other}, I booked the sauna module. For two. The booking system is very discreet.
My doctor says I should reduce stress. She suggested a nightly routine. I suggested you.
I do not need the AI to tell me when I am attracted to you. My pulse is a reliable instrument.
I have a very large tool shed. Rarely used. Always clean. Open to visitors.
If you are cold, {other}, I know a way to warm up that does not use the heater and takes all night.
I would love to see your reactor core, {other}. Just the diagrams. For now.
A little bird told me you like it rough. The rover trail, I mean. The bumpy one. Late at night.
I will be in the shower after shift. The water allowance is exactly two minutes. Joining me saves water.
Let us skip the training video and learn on the job, {other}. Hands-on. All night.
Stop looking at me like that. People will think we have something to hide. We do. It is a very nice hide.
I have a bunk with a very squeaky frame. I am telling you so you can plan accordingly.
My idea of a quiet evening is you, me and a very long ration of nothing to do.
You said you wanted something hot and satisfying. I have soup. And options.
I have very strong opinions about shared showers. Mostly in favour.
{other}, if I fall off the schedule, please come looking for me. Start in my quarters.
I cleared the whole night shift. Do not ask how. Just clear yours as well.
Do not tell the commander, {other}, but I have a thing for people who read the safety manual aloud.
I want to introduce you to my favourite spot on the observation deck. It is dark and it has a blanket.
The greenhouse is nice and humid at night, {other}. Bring a towel. And no excuses.
We could test the emergency bunk together. The manual says it holds two. Closely.
Some people count sheep. I count how many times you smiled at me today. Insomnia has never been so good.
{other}, you should know that I take my coffee black and my evenings slow.
I like a person who handles pressure well. I like it even better when they handle me.
I booked the supply closet for the afternoon. Do not look so shocked. The mop is lovely.
Tell me your name, rank and what you are doing at nine o'clock, because I would like to be there.
{other}, if this relationship had a status page, it would say: critical, pending hugs.
You are the only sensor that sets off my alarms. Come over and silence them.
I like to think that, under all this standard-issue grey, we are both a little bit scandalous.

flirt.text: {other}, you look good today. Not that I was looking. Okay, I was looking.
I saved you the good seat in the canteen. It has only one wobble.
Your smile is the brightest thing on this base, and we have a fusion reactor.
You know what this base needs? More of whatever you are doing.
I made you a coffee. It is terrible. The thought is excellent.
Walk with me to the observation deck? I will tell you about the stars. I will pretend I know them.
{other}, you make a regulation jumpsuit look like a fashion choice.
I like how you laugh at my jokes, even the ones about plumbing.
Do you have a minute? Or an hour? Or a rest of the shift?
They say the soil here is poor. But look what grows around you.
I thought about you when the sun came up. It was a lamp, but still.
You are the first person I look for in the mess hall. Do not tell the others.
I traded my dessert ration for a good seat next to you. Worth it.
Every time you speak, the day improves by about ten percent. I measured.
Do you ever get tired of being this charming? Because I am tired of noticing.
{other}, I wrote you a poem. It rhymes oxygen with, well, nothing. Still working on it.
I was going to ask for a repair. Then I saw you and forgot what was broken.
If you need a listening ear, I have two. They are free after dinner.
You are the best reason to leave my quarters.
Is it wrong to wish the shift would run long, if you are on it?
I like the way you think, {other}. And the way you talk. And the way you walk. Mostly the whole thing.
I do not say this to everyone: you are my favourite colleague.
I put a small plant on your desk. It is basil. It means I like you. Or I like pasta. Both.
Your sense of humour keeps me going. That and the cheese substitute.
I would give you my last bar of chocolate. That is how serious this is.
{other}, I borrowed your pen. I am never giving it back. It reminds me of you.
You know that thing where time slows down? It happens when you are in the room.
I would walk the whole habitat ring with you. Twice. Without a map.
You have a calming voice. I would listen to you read a spare-parts catalogue.
I am so glad the supply ship brought you here. I would have sent a thank-you note.
Want to share a table? I promise to chew with my mouth closed.
I like your style, {other}. Practical, clean, a little bit dangerous. Like a good tool.
Somebody told me the secret to a good colony is good company. Hello, good company.
{other}, I am planning a picnic in the dome. I have two sandwiches and a very big hope.
You are the reason my shift flies by. And my lunch break lasts too short.
Just so you know, my eyes are up here. Oh. No, keep looking. It is fine.
Can I tell you something? I like your sleeves. I like what is in them. The arms. The arms are great.
I never believed in destiny until the rota put us on the same shift.
I am not good at flirting, {other}. I am great at remembering what you said last Tuesday.
If I were a repair ticket, I would want you to pick me up first.
Your timing is perfect. Like a good airlock cycle. No lag. Just you.
Remember me when you are famous, {other}. I will be the one behind you with a nice sign.
You laugh and the whole mess hall looks up. I would like a share of that.
I told the AI I want to improve my mood. It showed me your picture. Fine, that is not true. It showed me ads. But I thought of you.
Is it okay if I sit here? The other seats are fine. I just like this one.
I like your voice on the radio. It is like a warm blanket on a cold night.
Do you think we would be good at running a colony together? Or a greenhouse?
I saw the sunrise lamps come on this morning. I thought, I should tell {other}. So here I am.
You smell like fresh soap and good ideas. In that order.
I brought you something from the garden. It is a tomato. I picked the best one. It has a face.
When you smile, my morale goes up. The AI wants to measure it. I told it to mind its own business.
Hey {other}. I tried to think of a pickup line. I failed. Hello.
Your eyes are the best view on the base. And we have a crater.
You make the long nights shorter, {other}. I am not sure how. I am not complaining.
Would you like to be my plus one? For any event. All events. The next party. The meal. Life.
{other}, I think you are great. I thought you should know before the next supply run.
I am organising a very small, very quiet dinner for two. Interested?
You are the only person I want to be stuck in an elevator with. Or a lift core. Or a hallway.
I like how you hum when you are happy. I would like to be in the group of reasons.
Look, {other}, I have a spare ticket for the film night. It is free. I am free.
You have a talent for making this place feel like home. I would like to share the home bit.
I am no poet, but you make me want to reach for a pen. And then a dictionary.
You are like a perfect day on a good planet. Rare. Warm. Easy on the eyes.
I think you are cool. Cooler than the cryo-store. And that is a high bar.
{other}, you wear confidence well. It suits you. It could suit me too, if you share.
I am glad we are friends. I would be glad if we were a little more. Just saying.
I put a star on your name on the roster. It means you are special. Please do not check.
I like your company, and the way the corridor seems brighter when you pass.
It is a long way to the nearest neighbour planet. I am glad I have you down the hall.
Are you busy tonight? If yes, it is fine. If no, there is a very good rerun on.
I saved a bit of the cake for you. It is your size. It is the biggest size.
You would make a lovely co-pilot. I do not even have a ship.
People talk about the stars. I think the best things in this galaxy are between you and me and a good cup of tea.
I like how you do not take yourself too seriously, except your coffee.
You are very good at your job, {other}. And I would not mind being your project.
If you ever need someone to carry the groceries, I have strong arms. And a cart.
Your stories are the only entertainment I look forward to. The film library has nothing on you.
Hey, {other}. I got you a gift. It is a key ring. It has a tiny rocket. Now you will think of me every time you leave.
I think we make a great team. I would like to be on your team full time.
You could read me the supply manifest and I would still blush.
I like how you say my name. I am saving it in my memory banks.
They gave us a heart rate monitor for the wellness programme. Mine goes crazy near you. I hope that is normal.
I took the long way round to your office. I took it three times.
You are my favourite person to bump into. Literally. In the corridor. Again.
I like seeing you smile at the end of a shift. It is like a small sunrise.
You are what I will miss most when the contract ends. So I am going to extend it.
Honestly, {other}? If this base is a story, you are my favourite chapter.

joke: I asked the AI for a joke. It sent me a subscription offer.
Why did the technician cross the airlock? To get to the other side. It took forty minutes.
My suit and I have an agreement. It does not leak, I do not complain.
I told the rover to go slow. It said, that is my only speed.
They called it a smart habitat. It still cannot find my left sock.
Our greenhouse produced a tomato the size of my head. I named it Gerald.
The ration bar tastes like cardboard with ambitions.
I would tell you a joke about vacuum, but it is empty.
My blood type is coffee positive.
Somebody left a spreadsheet in the airlock. It was cycled out. Best outcome in months.
The AI says it learns from us. That explains the mood swings.
I dreamt in pie charts last night. Quarterly pie charts. I woke up screaming.
My boss said we are a family. Then he scheduled me for a double shift. Classic family.
I like our dust storms. They keep the visitors out.
The recycler made me a lovely tea. I choose not to ask what it was yesterday.
I put the kettle on and the whole base lost power. I stand by the kettle.
A hydroponics joke: it never gets old. It just grows on you.
Did you hear the commander tried to fix the vending machine? The vending machine won.
I asked for a window office. They gave me a window. In the corridor. Facing a wall.
I have been on this colony for months and I still cannot pronounce the water recycler.
They said there would be gravity on this planet. They did not say how much.
My shift ended at six. My to-do list did not get the message.
The best thing about the airlock is the two minutes of peace between doors.
The AI-powered toaster has opinions. I do not like them.
Someone ate my labelled yoghurt. It was labelled in Latin. Still no excuse.
rivalry: Oh, you are working today, {other}? What an unusual change of pace.
I saw your report, {other}. Bold choice, formatting it like a ransom note.
Some of us have actual deadlines, {other}.
Funny, I do not remember anyone asking your opinion. I have checked the minutes.
Nice of you to join us, {other}. We started the shift four hours ago.
I am not saying I am better than you, {other}. The ledger is.
I would help you with that, {other}, but I would hate to steal your learning moment.
Interesting theory, {other}. Shall we try it? On you?
Your mug says World's Best Colleague. I checked. It is a lie.
Congratulations on the promotion, {other}. Truly. I am only a little bit sick.
{other}, I am going to need you to stop breathing so loudly in my airlock.
I saw what you did with the budget, {other}. Pure art. I mean, a horror painting.
Of course you got the extra ration. You always know the right person to flatter.
I will let your mistake slide, {other}. This time. And the three times before.
{other}, I am just curious. Is it hard being wrong so confidently?
Do not worry, {other}, nobody expects much from you. It is a very low bar. You still tripped on it.
You are dripping on my clean floor, {other}. I would say it is a metaphor. But it is just water.
Race you to the next promotion, {other}. I will wait for you at the top. With a sandwich.
awkward: Oh. Um. That is very kind. I have a thing. Somewhere else. Right now.
I am flattered, {other}. I am also, um, going to look at that wall for a bit.
That is sweet, {other}, but I think we should keep it professional. Very professional.
I... did not realise. Sorry. I need to check my pocket for something. Anything.
Right. Okay. I will just pretend I did not hear that. Deal?
{other}, you are great. Really. Please stop saying things now.
I think the air is thin in here. I need to leave. For air.
Thanks. I am, um, seeing someone. Their name is Paperwork.
Oh dear. I am the wrong person for that, {other}. I would love to stay friends. If you still want.
I do not know what to say. So I will say: nice weather. In the dome. Under the lamps.
That landed badly. I can feel the room cooling. We should both leave.
I appreciate the effort, {other}. I will treasure it. Quietly. Alone. Far away.
Is there a pause button for this conversation? Asking for me.
Um. {other}. I think you meant someone else. Someone with different plans.
Okay, that was a lot. I am going to go and not think about that. Starting now.
{other}, I am committed. To my work. To my houseplant. Not to that.
I am going to pretend my radio just rang. Beep beep. Sorry, must go.
You are brave, {other}. I am a coward. I am leaving.
Ha ha. Good one. That was a joke, right? Please say joke.
{other}, I think we both need a very long cup of tea. Separately.
decline: That is very sweet, {other}. I will take it as a compliment and nothing else.
Thank you, {other}. I do not think it would work. But you are a good friend.
I am flattered. I am also taken. Or not interested. Both, really.
I am going to leave before this gets worse for either of us.
Kind of you, {other}. No. But kind.
flirt_reply: You are too much, {other}. Please keep going.
Ha! You are trouble. I like trouble.
Stop it. No, do not stop it.
I am blushing. I hope the lamp hides it.
You say the nicest things. Say more.
I was hoping you would say that.
Is that right? Tell me again, slower.
You are the best part of my day, {other}.
I should be working. I would rather be here.
innuendo_reply: {other}! You cannot say that in the corridor. Say it again in my quarters.
Is that what they teach in orientation now? I should have paid more attention.
You are outrageous, {other}. Do not ever change.
I will pretend I did not hear that. I heard it. I am pretending badly.
That was either a fantastic line or a medical symptom. I am happy either way.
Keep talking like that and the AI will flag us for wellbeing.
I like the way you think. The way it goes sideways.
I accept. Whatever it was. I accept.
If I blush, blame the humidity.
You are a menace. Please stay a menace.
Bold. I like bold. Say it again when nobody is listening.
My ears are burning. My cheeks too. This is a very good feeling.
party_talk: Great music! Who picked it? Whoever it was, a raise for them.
I have not danced in months. My knees have opinions.
Did you try the dip? It is the green thing. It is the only thing.
{other}, you have a lovely dress. I did not know the colony had dresses.
I am only here for the snacks. And the company. Mostly the snacks.
This is the first time I have not talked about work all day. Do not remind me.
Who is DJ? Is it the AI? It has played the same song four times.
Cheers, {other}. To getting out of that suit for one night.
A party! In this economy! Brilliant.
I love how the lights go. I could dance all night. I will dance until the lights flicker.
I like seeing everybody out of uniform. We look like humans.
Hold my drink. I have a move.
Have you met the guest of honour? They are lovely. They are also hiding.
I am here to make memories. Or at least blurry photos.
I will have one more drink and then I will leave. Famous last words.
Is the floor supposed to be sticky? It adds character.
The best parties happen when the shift ends. This one just started.
I came for the cake. Where is the cake?
Thank you for inviting me. I almost stayed in to do laundry.
I think the dome is great for parties. You can see the stars while you embarrass yourself.
Somebody should start a dance-off. I will not. But somebody should.
I will go and talk to that person by the wall. Wish me luck.
The punch is a mystery. I recommend it.
I have a theory the AI is hosting this party. It keeps asking for feedback.
Free snacks are the best snacks.
We should do this every week. Not every week. Every month. Every week is too many hangovers.
Everyone I like is in the same room. This is the dream.
I am going to dance badly and not care. Join me.
It is nice to see the commander smile. It looks painful, but nice.
Is it true the dome club has a robot DJ? I want one for my birthday.
toast: To {name}! May the oxygen never run out and the coffee never run dry.
A toast to {name}: the best thing about this base, after the airlocks.
To {name}! Another year, another airlock cycle survived.
Raise your glasses for {name}. They make the colony brighter.
To {name}, who keeps us sane. Mostly.
To {name}! We would be lost without you. Probably literally.
Cheers to {name}. May your luck be like a fresh seal: tight and reliable.
To {name}, the heart of this place. A heart with excellent pressure.
Let us drink to {name}. Because we can. Because we deserve it.
To {name}! Long may you reign over the canteen schedule.
To friends, to family, and to {name}, who is a bit of both.
To {name}: proof that good things survive in bad environments.
Here is to {name}. May your days be long and your shifts be short.
To {name}! You made it. We are all very proud. And a little tipsy.
To {name}, our favourite person. Do not tell the others.
A toast to the occasion: {reason}. Nobody deserves it more than {name}.
Friends, colleagues, strangers who got free snacks: to {name}!
To {name}. I have a speech. It is one word. Cheers!
Glasses up. To {name}. May they never have to attend another budget meeting.
To {name}! And to the AI which, for once, did not ruin the evening.
sing: Oh, the air is thin and the pay is low, but my heart is full, so off we go!
I will always love you, little greenhouse, even if you give me blight!
Take me home, rover road, to the place where the oxygen is mine!
Row, row, row your rover, gently down the crater!
Twinkle, twinkle, little base, how I wonder what is for lunch!

birthday: It is {name}'s birthday. Throw a party?
{name} has a birthday today. A party would mean a lot.
promotion: {name} has been promoted. Throw a party?
A promotion for {name}! The crew would like to celebrate.
goal: The colony reached a goal: {reason}. Throw a party?
A goal is done: {reason}. People want to celebrate.
medal: {name} earned a medal. Throw a party?
A medal for {name}. A party would suit.
structure: The {reason} is finished. Throw a party to open it?
wedding: {name} and the new spouse just got married. Throw a wedding party?
adoption: {name} adopted a child. Throw a welcome party?
A new family member. Throw a welcome party?
record: {name} set a record on the arcade. Throw a party?

auto_small: Nobody threw a party, so people gathered by themselves for {reason}.
A few friends of {name} met in the {place} anyway.

drama_small.text: {a} spilled a drink on {b}. Everybody laughed. {b} laughed a little less.
{a} knocked over the snack table. The dip is a total loss.
{a} flirted with {b} in front of everyone. {b} looked for the exit.
{a} told a bad joke. The silence was impressive.
{a} and {b} started a dance-off. The crowd voted for chaos.
{a} got tipsy and sang. Several people clapped. Several people left.
{a}'s ex arrived. The room went quiet. Then the music went on.
